tess: Need a tiny customer-facing 'burst readiness' quickrun for tomorrow0h demo. Must cover caching, batching, streaming fallback, telemetry checks, and a simple renewal-risk signal. Keep it copy-pasteable.
omar: I'll draft. Make it one page max and include exact headers/snippets customers can paste.
raj: Core asks: reduce duplicate token spend during repeated queries, keep interactive UX snappy, and have a clear triage ladder for CS.
omar: Draft (customer-facing):
- Auth & model pin: Confirm API key in env + model pinned in settings. Run 3 test calls: short prompt, long context, edge-case input.
- Cache (if you control CDN/proxy):
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=25, stale-while-revalidate=45
  X-Redwood-Tenant: r_demo_42
- Client batching hint (recommended starting values):
  JS: client.generate({batchPolicy:{maxBatchTokens:700, maxWaitMs:50}})
  Python: client.generate(..., batch_policy={"max_batch_tokens":700, "latency_slo_ms":120})
- Streaming: prefer for UI. If partial-chunk errors appear, switch temporarily to polling with interval 1s.
- Telemetry quick checks (hourly): total_reqs, 95p_latency_ms, 4xx_rate, 5xx_rate, unique_intents. Example SQL:
  SELECT count(*) AS reqs, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95, sum(case when status>=500 then 1 else 0 end) AS s5xx FROM requests WHERE tenant='r_demo_42' AND ts > now()-interval '1 hour';
- Renewal-risk score (0-3) for customer dashboard language:
  0 Healthy: steady QPS, low errors
  1 Watch: small latency drift or occasional 4xx
  2 Engage: sustained latency above target or repeated errors; schedule touch
  3 Escalate: major QPS drop or >3% 5xx; open CS+SRE call
- Quick rollback plays: pin to last-good model, reduce batch size by 50%, disable streaming on affected endpoints.
- Capacity requests: email capacity@redwood (cc ops) for >8x baseline bursts.
tess: Can you also give a 48h CS rep checklist? Keep checklist steps short.
omar: 48h CS rep quick steps:
- 0-2h: Validate keys & model pin, run smoke prompts, record results
- 2-12h: Enable short shared cache (20-30s), start hourly telemetry snapshots, watch for error spikes
- 12-24h: If median latency > target, reduce batch tokens and lower maxWaitMs; validate streaming experience end-to-end
- 24-48h: Compute renewal-risk score, log qualitative feedback, schedule follow-up if score >=2
raj: Looks good. I'll add this to #cs-assets and attach a concise PDF. ops-bot: Auto-note: link sent to confluence /cs/runbooks.
tess: Thanks team 10min edit and share with field ops before the demo.
